현장실습을 중도에 포기하거나 불성실하게 참여할 경우 학점이 부여되지 않으며, 실습비 지급이 제한될 수 있으니 유의하시기 바랍니다.

en: (To be assigned by each host organization)

- Students of the Department of Naval Architecture and Ocean Engineering can have this course recognized as major elective credits for their primary major.
(However, the cooperative education (internship) courses <Practical Application of Engineering Knowledge (3 credits), Cooperative Education Course 1 (1 credit), Cooperative Education Course 2 (2 credits), Cooperative Education Course 3 (3 credits)> are recognized as 전선 (major elective) credits for the primary major up to a maximum of 3 credits in total.)
- Students from other departments should ask their own department whether this course can be recognized as major elective credits.
- Students taking a cooperative education course cannot take any other course in the seasonal session (including online/remote courses).

en: 채용연계형 (recruitment-linked type: the internship can lead to a job offer)

(1 month) 29 Dec (Tue) – 28 Jan (Thu)
5 days a week (Mon–Fri)
08:00~17:00 (includes a 1-hour break)

- Job: research, basic design, production management
- Departments: Merchant Ship Business Division, EPU, Special Ship Business Division, AX Business Division, Product Strategy & Technology Institute, Manufacturing Headquarters

Week 1: Orientation run by HR and introduction to the production site (Geoje head office)
Week 2: Meeting the assigned department; project planning with the department head / mentor
Week 3: Project work and mentoring
Week 4: Summarising project results and preparing the results presentation
Week 5: Project results presentation; top performers enter the selection process for the 산학장학생 (industry-sponsored scholarship student) programme

1) Major: Naval Architecture and Ocean Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical and Computer Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science and Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Civil and Environmental Engineering, Architecture, Energy Resources Engineering, Nuclear Engineering, Chemical and Biological Engineering, Materials Science and Engineering
2) Year: 3rd year or above
3) GPA: no requirement
4) Other
- Interns who complete the programme with excellent results are linked to the industry-sponsored scholarship selection, and get an interview opportunity in new-graduate recruitment (document screening passed)
- Students who are already industry-sponsored scholarship students of another company may be restricted from participating.

1) Internship pay: KRW 2,500,000 in total (2,500,000원), before tax
2) Lunch provided
3) Dormitory provided (only for interns working in Geoje)

When applying, write the preferred job field (1st and 2nd choice)

blocks.en: From the product contract stage, works with the sales organization in discussions with customers. Decides the product's main particulars, its performance and the technical specifications of various equipment and devices, and prepares cost estimates. Prepares technical documents such as specifications (instructions) and initial drawings Basic Design Design and so decides the initial form of the product. (Seoul) Works closely with shipowners, classification societies, equipment suppliers and others. Also develops new technologies and new products that lead the changing market, and takes the lead in making the company more competitive in winning orders.
blocks.ko: 제품 계약 단계부터 영업조직과 함께 고객과의 협의에 참여하여 제품의 제원, 성능 및 각종 장비/장치의 기술 사양을 결정하고 견적을 수행하며, 사양서(instructions) 및 초기도면 등 기술자료를 기본설계 설계 작성하여 제품의 초기 모습을 결정합니다. (서울) 선주/선급/장비공급업체 등과 유기적으로 협업할 뿐만 아니라, 변화하는 시장 상황을 주도하는 신기술/신제품을 개발하는 업무를 수행하며 수주 경쟁력 확보에 앞장섭니다.

blocks.en: (Production Management) Manages the schedule, quality, safety, materials, manpower and budget of each type of shipbuilding work as one whole. Continuously improves process efficiency and quality competitiveness through production strategies and better construction methods.
blocks.ko: (생산관리) 선박 각 공종의 일정·품질·안전·자재·인원·예산을 통합 관리하며 생산 전략과 공법 개선을 통해 공정 효율과 품질 경쟁력을 지속적으로 향상시킵니다.

blocks.en: (Commissioning) Oversees the FAT (Factory Acceptance Test) and commissioning of the ship's main equipment, as well as mooring and sea trials. Secures final delivery quality through standardized procedures and support for shipowners. Production Management (Geoje) (Quality Control) Sets inspection standards based on quality requirements such as contracts, specifications and drawings. Carries out quality inspections for all types of work to make sure products meet the specifications Production Management
blocks.ko: (시운전) 선박 주요 장비의 FAT 및 시운전과 계류·해상 시험을 총괄하고 표준화된 절차와 선주 지원을 통해 최종 인도 품질을 확보합니다. 생산관리 (거제) (품질관리) 계약·규격·도면 등 품질 요구사항을 기반으로 검사 기준을 수립하고 전 공종 품질 검사를 수행하여 제품의 규격 충족을 생산 관리합니다. 관리

blocks.en: (Plant Engineering / Facilities) Responsible for investment in and maintenance of shipyard facilities and equipment, and for production operations in general. Pursues efficient operation through energy and greenhouse gas management systems.
blocks.ko: (공무) 조선소 시설·설비의 투자 및 유지관리와 생산 전반 운영을 담당하며 에너지·온실가스 관리 체계를 통해 효율적 운영을 추진합니다.

blocks.en: Plans and operates HSE (Health, Safety and Environment) systems and manages management indicators. Interprets and applies the relevant laws and regulations, and manages how HSE is carried out. (Geoje) Also manages safety risks through process safety management, risk assessment, on-site inspections and training. Supports the prevention of serious accidents and the safety management system.
blocks.ko: HSE 제도 기획·운영과 경영지표 관리, 관련 법규의 해석·적용 및 HSE 이행 관리를 수행합니다. (거제) 또한 공정안전관리, 위험성 평가, 현장 점검·교육 등을 통해 안전 리스크를 관리하고 중대재해 예방 및 안전경영 체계를 지원합니다.

blocks.ko: 1 / 3 직무 구분 담당업무 (근무지)

blocks.en: Analyzes work processes and data to find AI transformation (AX) projects, drives innovation based on AI and machine learning, and develops data-driven digital solutions AX Solutions. (Seoul) Builds and operates the company-wide data platform and data pipelines. Secures a stable foundation for using data through data standards, quality and security.
blocks.ko: 업무 프로세스와 데이터를 분석하여 AI 전환(AX) 과제를 발굴하고 AI·머신러닝 기반의 혁신을 추진하며, 데이터 기반 디지털 솔루션을 AX솔루션 개발합니다. (서울) 전사 데이터 플랫폼과 파이프라인을 구축·운영하고 데이터 표준· 품질·보안을 통해 안정적인 활용 기반을 확보합니다.

blocks.en: Designs automated equipment for production processes such as welding and machining, as well as factory layouts, to build a smart production environment Equipment/Facility. Improves process AX Automation Development precision and efficiency through control technologies based on sensors and robots. (Geoje) Integrates and applies facilities, including logistics automation systems and collaborative robots, to link production with logistics. Improves work safety and productivity.
blocks.ko: 용접·가공 등 생산 공정의 자동화 장비와 공장 레이아웃을 설계하여 장비/설비 스마트 생산 환경을 구축하고, 센서·로봇 기반 제어 기술로 공정 AX 자동화 개발 정밀도와 효율을 향상시킵니다. (거제) 물류 자동화 시스템과 협동로봇을 포함한 설비를 통합·적용하여 생산과 물류를 연계하고, 작업 안전성과 생산성을 제고합니다.

blocks.en: Builds a smart operation system based on digital twins. Improves operational efficiency and decision-making through the collection, analysis and visualization of production data. Production Intelligence Develops AI-based technologies for production planning and risk prediction, and a digital work order system (Geoje). Advances the production management system through SAP modules and process and space optimization.
blocks.ko: 디지털 트윈 기반 스마트 운영 시스템을 구축하고, 생산 데이터 수집·분석·가시화를 통해 운영 효율과 의사결정 수준을 향상시킵니다. 생산지능화 AI 기반 생산계획·리스크 예측 기술과 디지털 작업 오더 체계를 (거제) 개발하고, SAP 모듈 및 공정·공간 최적화를 통해 생산관리 체계를 고도화합니다.

blocks.en: Researches and develops optimization technologies that improve the efficiency and performance of innovative new-concept propellers, Performance Optimization Energy Saving Devices, hull forms and similar items that can be used on decarbonized, eco-friendly ships Research. To do this, combines numerical analysis with experimental verification (Seoul). The goals are better fuel efficiency, lower greenhouse gas emissions and better ship operating performance.
blocks.ko: 탈탄소 친환경 선박에 적용이 가능한 혁신적인 신개념 추진기, 성능최적화 Energy Saving Device, 선형 등의 효율성과 성능 향상을 위한 연구 최적화 기술을 개발하고 연구합니다. 이를 위해 수치해석과 실험적 (서울) 검증을 병행하며, 연료 효율 개선, 온실가스 배출 저감, 선박 운항 성능 향상을 목표로 합니다.

blocks.en: Various structural engineering work needed to develop and verify products, structure / strength and fatigue analysis of structures, analysis of vibration and noise, and devices that reduce them
blocks.ko: 제품 개발과 검증에 필요한 다양한 구조 엔지니어링 및 구조물의 구조/ 강도/피로 해석, 진동/소음에 관한 해석과 이를 감소시키는 장치를

blocks.en: R&D Vibration & Noise Research are researched and developed. Develops the structure of large Energy (Seoul) Saving Devices, such as wind-assisted propulsion systems, and makes them lighter. Also researches technologies related to underwater radiated noise.
blocks.ko: R&D 진동소음연구 연구하고 개발합니다. 풍력 보조 추진시스템과 같은 대형 Energy (서울) Saving Device 구조 개발 및 경량화, 수중방사소음과 관련된 기술 연구를 수행합니다.

blocks.en: Uses expert knowledge of the hydrodynamics of floating bodies in waves to meet the special technical needs of various marine environments, such as seakeeping, maneuvering, mooring, DP (Dynamic Positioning) and sloshing Hydrodynamics Research. On this basis, (Seoul) carries out research to further advance the engineering capabilities of the company's main products. Also uses this expertise to focus on developing innovative new-concept products.
blocks.ko: 파랑 중에 놓인 부유체에 대한 유체 관련 전문 지식을 바탕으로 내항, 조종, 계류, DP(Dynamic Positioning), 슬로싱 등 다양한 유체연구 해양 환경에서의 특수한 기술과 요구에 대응하며, 이를 토대로 (서울) 회사의 주력 제품들의 엔지니어링 역량을 더욱 고도화하는 연구를 수행합니다. 이러한 전문적인 역량을 활용하여 신개념의 혁신적인 제품들을 개발하는 데에도 주력하고 있습니다.

blocks.ko: 2 / 3 직무 구분 담당업무 (근무지)

blocks.en: Researches and develops eco-friendly systems and equipment for unmanned and electrified ships (including package equipment with pumps, Control Intelligence compressors and similar items) and automation systems. Research Handles electrical system integration engineering and develops electrification technology for power conversion devices, switchboards, propulsion motors, ESS and other parts of electric propulsion systems (Seoul). Also develops technologies for autonomous ships.
blocks.ko: 선박 무인화·전동화를 위한 친환경 시스템 및 장비(Pump, 제어지능화 Compressor 등을 포함한 패키지 장비 등) 자동화 시스템 연구개발, 연구 전기추진시스템용 전력 변환 장치, 배전반, 추진 모터, ESS 등에 대한 (서울) 전기 시스템 통합 엔지니어링 및 전동화 기술 개발, 자율화를 위한 기술을 개발합니다.

blocks.en: Researches and develops tanks that can safely store various liquefied gases such as LNG, LPG, LCO2, LNH3 and LH2. CCS Solution To do this, carries out basic research, including research on materials and development of core technologies for liquefied gas storage tanks Research. Also carries out commercialization research through tank design, analysis and demonstration (Seoul). The goal is to develop liquefied gas storage tank products that can be safely used on ships and offshore products.
blocks.ko: LNG, LPG, LCO2, LNH3, LH2와 같은 다양한 액화가스를 안전하게 저장할 수 있는 탱크 연구 및 개발을 수행합니다. CCS솔루션 이를 위해 액화가스 저장탱크와 관련된 소재 연구 및 요소기술 개발을 연구 포함한 기반 연구를 진행하고 있으며, 탱크의 설계, 해석, 실증을 통한 (서울) 상용화 연구도 수행합니다. 선박 및 해양 제품에 안전하게 적용할 수 있는 액화가스 저장탱크 제품을 개발하는 것을 목표로 하고 있습니다.

blocks.en: Carries out process engineering and system development for the stable handling of cryogenic gas cargo, from traditional fossil fuels such as LNG and LPG CHS Solution to eco-friendly fuels such as ammonia and hydrogen. Research Based on this, (Seoul) pursues the development of eco-friendly technologies R that help reduce carbon emissions and switch to carbon-free fuels. & Researches technologies for switching to eco-friendly fuels such as ammonia and hydrogen, and D Propulsion System propulsion technologies for future products such as fuel cells and SMRs (small modular reactors). Research Operates facilities to demonstrate the developed technologies and verify their performance, (Seoul) and carries out research to commercialize them.
blocks.ko: LNG, LPG와 같은 전통적인 화석연료부터 암모니아, 수소와 같은 CHS솔루션 친환경 연료에 이르기까지, 극저온 가스화물의 안정적인 처리를 연구 위한 공정 엔지니어링 및 시스템 개발을 수행합니다. 이를 바탕으로 (서울) 탄소배출 저감 및 무탄소 연료 전환에 기여하는 친환경 기술 R 개발을 추진합니다. & 암모니아, 수소 등 친환경 연료로 전환하기 위한 대응 기술과 D 추진시스템 연료전지, SMR 등 미래 제품에 적용할 추진 기술을 연구합니다. 연구 개발 기술을 실증하고 성능을 검증하기 위한 설비를 운용하며 (서울) 상용화하기 위한 연구를 수행합니다.

blocks.en: Secures core technologies specific to naval ships. Carries out optimal design that considers stealth and survivability, and researches, develops and demonstrates key systems and equipment. Naval Ship Performance Research Also analyzes stealth performance factors such as underwater radiated noise (URN), acoustic target strength (T/S), sonar self-noise, radar (Seoul) cross section (RCS), infrared signature (IR) and noise/vibration, and develops technologies to reduce them. Advances integrated survivability analysis based on susceptibility, vulnerability (including shock resistance) and recoverability, as well as in-house analysis technologies.
blocks.ko: 함정 특화 핵심 기술 확보를 통해 은밀성과 생존성을 고려한 최적 설계와 주요 시스템·장비의 연구·개발·실증을 수행합니다. 함정성능연구 또한 수중방사소음(URN), 음향표적강도(T/S), 소나 자체소음, 레이더 (서울) 반사면적(RCS), 적외선 신호(IR), 소음·진동 등 스텔스 성능 요소를 분석하고 저감 기술을 개발하며, 피격성·취약성(내충격 포함)·회복성 기반 통합 생존성 분석과 자체 해석 기술을 고도화합니다.

blocks.en: Researches and develops core technologies for smart naval ships, domestic production of weapon systems, and electric propulsion. Develops component technologies for smart naval ships that combine ICT, artificial intelligence and automation, reduced-manning platforms, Naval Ship Systems Research equipment for naval ship system integration and combined performance evaluation, condition-based maintenance (CBM), integrated product support (IPS) and similar items (Seoul). Secures electric propulsion system technology by developing and testing submarine weapon launch systems and by researching the integration and optimization of naval fuel cell systems and batteries.
blocks.ko: 함정의 스마트화, 무장 체계 국산화 및 전기추진 관련 핵심 기술 연구 및 개발을 수행합니다. ICT, 인공지능, 자동화 기술을 접목한 스마트 함정 요소기술, 병력 절감형 플랫폼, 함정체계 연동 및 복합 함정체계연구 성능평가장비, 상태기반정비(CBM), 통합체계지원(IPS) 등을 (서울) 개발하며, 잠수함 무장 발사 장치 개발 및 시험, 함정용 연료전지 시스템과 배터리 통합·최적화 연구를 통해 전기추진시스템 기술을 확보합니다.

english: The field-practice application for 『현장실습 3』 (Field Practice 3), a course of the internship semester program (실습학기제) in the 2026 winter session, is announced below. All interested students are encouraged to apply.

In 『현장실습 3』 (Field Practice 3), the internship and the course run together, so you must register for the course. You cannot take any other course in the winter session, including online courses (any other courses you have already registered for will be cancelled). The schedules for course registration and tuition payment may differ from the regular schedule, so be sure to check the separate notice.
Please note: if you give up the internship partway through or do not take part properly, you will not receive credit, and payment of the internship allowance may be restricted.
